brand.name: Mayura Jewellers
brand.meaning: Mayura is the Sanskrit word for peacock — a creature that has stood for grace, renewal and quiet splendour in Indian art for three thousand years.
brand.positioning: Hallmarked 22K and 18K gold, certified diamonds and bridal heirlooms, made by hand for the families of Thakur Village and beyond.

owner.name: Darshil Bhandari
owner.message: My family has weighed gold across a counter for three generations. What I wanted for Mayura was simpler than a shop — a room where a mother could bring her daughter, ask every question she liked, and leave holding something she would still be proud of in thirty years. Every piece we sell is hallmarked, every diamond is certified, and every rate is written down before you decide. That is the whole promise.

assurances.title: Certified Diamonds
assurances.copy: Independently graded by IGI, GIA or SGL. The certificate travels with the piece.

assurances.title: Lifetime Exchange
assurances.copy: Exchange gold jewellery at the prevailing rate, for as long as you own it.

assurances.title: Transparent Pricing
